summary: Yeti-Switch is a transit class 4 softswitch and session border controller featuring an integrated billing and routing engine. It comes with a REST API for programmatic control over voice traffic management. As a class 4 switch, it is designed for wholesale VoIP operators handling high volumes of long-distance call routing between carriers.
goodFor: It suits telecommunications engineers and wholesale VoIP providers who need an open-source routing and billing engine for carrier-to-carrier traffic. It is ideal if you want to self-host your own transit switching infrastructure using a GPL-licensed codebase.
watchOut: The lack of recent commit activity and zero tagged releases indicate that you may encounter unmaintained code, missing documentation, or unpatched bugs. Operating a class 4 softswitch also requires deep domain expertise in SIP signaling, network security, and real-time media handling.
deployNotes: Since the application combines C++ and Ruby components, you will typically need to manage a relational database for billing data, along with a process manager like systemd or Foreman to handle the background worker processes. Proper firewall configuration and SIP port management are essential for exposing the signalling engine securely.
